Ground spice commonly used in Indian cooking and drinks, in Middle Eastern cooking and in Scandinavian baking
Dried and ground bark or quills of Cinnamomum verum, C. zeylanicum or C. aromaticum, used as a spice.
Dried and ground red pepper, characterised by a hot sensation when consumed as a spice.
Dried and ground, unopened flower buds of Syzygium aromaticum, used as a spice.
Dried and ground fruit or seed of Coriandrum sativum, used as a spice.
Dried and ground fruit or seeds of Cuminum cymimum, used as a spice.
Dried and ground mixture of spices for use in the preparation of Indian-style meals. Typical ingredients include the spices cumin, coriander seed and turmeric.
Dried fenugreek seeds used as a spice.
Dried and ground rhizome of Zingiber officinale, used as a spice.
Dried herbs including thyme, rosemary, oregano and sage, used to flavour various dishes.
Dry powder composed of ground yellow mustard seeds, for use in preparation of mustard paste or incorporation into other foods.
Dried and ground seed of Myristica fragrans (M. officinalis or M. aromatica), used as a spice.
Dried, and sometimes ground, leaves of Oreganum vulgare, used as a culinary herb.
Dried and ground fruit of red capsicums (sweet red peppers).
Dried and ground unripe fruit of the pepper tree (Piper nigrum), used as a spice.
Dried woody herb with fragrant needle-like green leaves on small stalks.
Dried floral stigma of the plant Crocus sativus, used as a spice. May be intact threads or ground.
Dry leaves of Salvia officinalis used as a herb.
Dried aromatic green leafy herb with a subtle anise-like flavour.
Dried, and sometimes ground, leaves of Thymus vulgaris, used as a culinary herb.
Dried and ground rhizome of Curcuma domestica or C. longa, used as a spice.
Dried and ground seeds of the Acacia species native to Australia.
Product sold as a replacement for regular table salt, containing predominantly potassium chloride.
Fine granules of sodium chloride sold for direct addition to foods, to which iodine has been added in the form of potassium iodate or iodide. May contain free-flowing agents.
Fine granules of sodium chloride sold for direct addition to foods. May contain free-flowing agents and small amounts of other minerals such as potassium.
Concentrated meat stock that is dried and supplied as a powder or compressed into a cube. Contains ingredients such as salt and flavours.

column2: Stock, liquid, all flavours (except fish), prepared from commercial powder or cube
column3: Savoury liquid prepared by diluting commercial stock powder or cubes with water. Can be consumed alone, or used as an ingredient to flavour recipes. Contains ingredients such as salt and flavours.

Powdered product intended for addition to meat and other ingredients to prepare Mexican-style dishes such as taco filling. Typical ingredients include salt, sugar, maize starch, spices, chilli and citric acid.
Fine white powder used to chemically leaven baked goods such as cakes. Composed of 50% cream of tartar, 25% baking soda (bicarb), and 25% starch.
Fine white powder used to chemically leaven baked goods such as cakes.
Purified, crystallised potassium bitartrate, used as the acid component of some fast acting baking powder mixtures.
Phospholipid-rich granular extract of soy beans, often used in baking and as an emulsifier, as purchased from supermarkets for domestic use.
Unflavoured light yellow granular proteinaceous powder. Used to sweeten and thicken soups, sauces and desserts.
Solution containing the substance vanillin, used as a flavouring agent.
Alcoholic extract of the vanilla bean (Vanilla plantifolia or V. tahitensis), used as a flavouring agent.

Fine white or pale yellow powder derived from fruit. Used as a thickening agent in food, and to give jelly-like consistency to jams and marmalades. Nutrient data may differ in commercial preparations.
A cream or pale grey powder with a fine, smooth texture. Active raising agent used domestically to leaven a wide range of breads, cakes and pastries.

Alcoholic beverage characterised by the presence of hops or preparations of hops, prepared by the yeast fermentation of an aqueous extract of malted or unmalted cereals (usually barley), using warm temperature fermentation. Greater than or equal to 5% v/v alcohol.

Alcoholic beverage characterised by the presence of hops or preparations of hops, prepared by the yeast fermentation of an aqueous extract of malted or unmalted cereals (usually barley), using low fermentation temperatures. Alcohol content between 4-4.9% v/v alcohol.

Alcoholic beverage characterised by the presence of hops or preparations of hops, prepared by the yeast fermentation of an aqueous extract of malted or unmalted cereals (usually barley), so as to restrict alcohol formation or to remove alcohol after fermentation. Products are described on label as mid strength. Alcohol content between 3-3.9% v/v alcohol.

Alcoholic beverage characterised by the presence of hops or preparations of hops, prepared by the yeast fermentation of an aqueous extract of malted or unmalted cereals (usually barley), so as to restrict alcohol formation or to remove alcohol after fermentation. Products are described on label as Light or Lite. Alcohol content between 1- less than 3% v/v alcohol.

column2: Alcoholic beverage, spirit, approximately 40% v/v, all (Brandy, Gin, Rum, Vodka and Whisky)
column3: Includes beverages obtained from the distillation of wine or fermented sugar, cereals or potatoes, or the fermented preparation of grapes or grape products.

column2: Alcoholic beverage, spirit, approximately 30% v/v, all (Brandy, Gin, Rum, Vodka and Whisky), cooked
column3: Includes beverages obtained from the distillation of wine or fermented sugar, cereals or potatoes, or the fermented preparation of grapes or grape products, that has been heated until a large proportion of alcohol has evaporated.
Alcoholic beverage prepared from fermented apples with significant residual sugars. Includes cider produced in Australia, New Zealand and Denmark. Approximately 4% alcohol.
Commercially prepared rice based sweet cooking wine, commonly used in Japanese style cooking.

Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice from the cabernet sauvignon grape, with prolonged grape skin contact to produce wine of a deep red colour. Includes wine produced in Australia. Approximately 12% v/v alcohol.

Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice from the merlot grape, with prolonged grape skin contact to produce wine of a deep red colour. Includes wine produced in Australia and New Zealand. Approximately 12% v/v alcohol.

Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice from the pinot noir grape, with prolonged grape skin contact to produce wine of a deep red colour. Includes wine produced in Australia and New Zealand. Approximately 12% v/v alcohol.

Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice from the shiraz grape, with prolonged grape skin contact to produce wine of a deep red colour. Includes wine produced in Australia only. Approximately 12% v/v alcohol.
Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice from red wine grapes, retaining significant quantities of dissolved carbon dioxide. Approximately 13% v/v alcohol.
Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice with prolonged contact with grape skins, that has been heated until the majority of alcohol has evaporated.
Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice so that the wine has a pale pink colour. Includes wine produced in Australia and New Zealand. Approximately 13% v/v alcohol.

Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice from the sauvignon blanc grape, produced with little contact with grape skins so that the wine is pale yellow in colour with little sugars remaining. Includes wine produced in Australia and New Zealand. Approximately 12% v/v alcohol.

Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice from the semillon grape, produced with little contact with grape skins so that the wine is pale yellow in colour with little sugars remaining. Includes wine produced in Australia only. Approximately 12% v/v alcohol.

Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice produced from the chardonnay grape, with little contact with grape skins so that the wine is pale yellow in colour with little sugars remaining. Includes wine produced in Australia. Approximately 13% v/v alcohol.

Alcoholic beverage prepared by fermentation of grape juice produced from the riesling grape, with little contact with grape skins so that the wine is pale yellow in colour with some sugars remaining. Includes wine produced in Australia. Approximately 12% v/v alcohol.
Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice with little contact with grape skins, then heated until the majority of alcohol has evaporated.

Alcoholic beverage prepared by fermentation of grape juice produced with little grape skin contact so that the wine is pale yellow in colour and retains significant quantities of dissolved carbon dioxide. Includes wine described as brut or semi-brut in style produced in Australia and France. Approximately 12% v/v alcohol.

Alcoholic beverage prepared by fermentation of grape juice with little grape skin contact, so that the wine is golden in colour and retains a high level of residual sugars (approximately 10% sugars). Includes botrytised wine produced in Australia and New Zealand. Approximately 10% v/v alcohol.
Sweet, alcoholic beverage prepared from fermented grape juice to which additional alcohol is added. Approximately 16% v/v alcohol.

column2: Wine, fortified, sherry, dry style (approximately 1% sugars)
column3: Fermented grape juice to which additional alcohol is added and with a low sugars content (approximately 1%). Approximately 18% v/v alcohol.

column2: Wine, fortified, sherry, sweet style (approximately 11% sugars)
column3: Fermented grape juice to which additional alcohol is added. Approximately 14% v/v alcohol.

column2: Beverage base, chocolate flavour, added vitamins & minerals (Milo)
column3: Dry beverage base used to prepare a chocolate flavoured beverage with the addition of milk. Typical ingredients include malted cereals, milk solids and cocoa. Contains added iron, calcium and vitamins B2, B3, B6, B12, C & D. Milo brand is an example of such a product.

column2: Beverage base, chocolate flavour, unfortified (Nesquik brand)
column3: Dry beverage base used to prepare a chocolate flavoured beverage with the addition of milk. Typical ingredients include sugar, cocoa, soy lecithin and salt. No added vitamins or minerals.

Unfortified powdered mixture of sugar and cocoa or chocolate used for mixing with milk or water to produce a beverage. Other ingredients may include maltodextrin, milk solids, soy lecithin, salt, flavour.
Powder produced from the liquor extracted from cocoa beans. Typically used to flavour beverages and in baking.

Commercially prepared protein powder from the hulled hempseed after the oil has been extracted, milled into powder and much of fibre removed by sieving to get concentrated protein. Product of New Zealand and imported.

column2: Protein powder, whey based, protein >70%, unfortified
column3: White powder prepared from cows milk by refining and dehydrating the whey component to achieve a protein content of greater than 70%. Does not contain added flavours, vitamins or minerals.

column2: Coffee, instant, dry powder or granules

column2: Coffee, instant, dry powder or granules, decaffeinated

column2: Coffee, black, from instant coffee powder, decaffeinated
column3: Beverage made from instant decaffeinated coffee powder or granules to which boiling water is added. Does not contain added flavour, milk or sugar.

column2: Coffee, espresso, from ground coffee beans
column3: Beverage prepared from ground coffee beans and a small amount of hot water, as purchased in takeaway outlets or restaurants. Does not contain added flavour, milk or sugar.

column2: Coffee, long black, from ground coffee beans
column3: Beverage prepared from ground coffee beans to which a large volume of hot water is added. Does not contain added milk, sugar, or flavour.

column2: Cordial base, 25% citrus fruit juice, regular

column2: Cordial base, 40% citrus fruit juice, regular

Concentrated sugar-based syrup containing a minimum of 5% blackcurrant juice, used to prepare a beverage by dilution with water.

column2: Cordial base, fruit juice/flavours, intense sweetened or diet
column3: Concentrated syrup containing fruit juice or fruit flavour and intense sweeteners (acesulphame potassium, cyclamate, sucralose).

column2: Juice, apple, commercial, added vitamin C

Commercial beverage prepared from crushed apples and blackcurrants. Does not contain added sugar.
Commercial or homemade liquid prepared from the endocarp of lemons.
Commercial or homemade liquid prepared from the endocarp of limes.
Commercial beverage which is prepared from the endocarp of oranges. Contains added vitamin C, but does not contain added sugar.
Commercial beverage prepared from 95% orange juice and 5% mango juice. Contains added vitamin C, but does not contain added sugar.
Commercial beverage prepared from tomato, carrot, sweet potato, celery, beetroot and other vegetable juices. Contains added salt, but no added sugar.
Commercially prepared product made from 20-35% apple juice, water, sugars and food acids. May contain added vitamin C.
Commercially prepared beverage made from approximately 6% blackcurrant juice, water, sugar and food acid. Contains added vitamin C.
Commercially prepared beverage made from 25% cranberry juice, water, sugar and food acid. May contain added vitamin C.
Commercially prepared beverage made from 25% orange juice, water, sugar and food acid. Does not contain added vitamin C.
Carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage containing water, sugar, cola flavour, caffeine and colours.
Decaffeinated, carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage containing water, sugar, cola flavour.

column2: Soft drink, cola flavour, intense sweetened or diet
column3: Carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage containing water, intense sweeteners, cola flavour, caffeine and colours.

column2: Soft drink, cola flavour, intense sweetened or diet, decaffeinated
column3: Decaffeinated, carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage containing water, intense sweeteners, cola flavour and colours.

column2: Soft drink, dry ginger ale or ginger beer, regular
column3: Carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage prepared from water, sugar, and colours.
Carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage prepared from water, sugar and citric acid.
Carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage prepared from water and sugar with added quinine.

column2: Soft drink, fruit flavours, intense sweetened or diet
column3: Carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage prepared from water, intense sweetener, fruit flavours and colours.

column2: Soft drink, tonic water, intense sweetened or diet
column3: Carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage prepared from water and intense sweetener with added quinine.

column2: Soft drink, energy drink, Red Bull
column3: Carbonated, non-alcoholic water-based flavoured beverage containing added caffeine, taurine, glucuronolactone, inositol, niacinamide, pantothenic acid, vitamins B6 and B12.

Carbonated, non-alcoholic water-based flavoured beverage containing added caffeine, taurine, guarana, inositol, glucoronolactone, pantothenic acid, vitamins B2, B3, B6 and B12. May also contain ginkgo bilboa extract.

column2: Kombucha, flavoured, added juice or intense sweeteners
column3: Beverage prepared by the fermentation of green or black tea with a combination of yeast and bacteria. Contains intense sweeteners and added flavours such as fruit juice. Ready to drink.

column2: Tea, regular, black, brewed from leaf or teabags, without milk
column3: Beverage prepared by brewing black tea leaves (dried, fermented leaves of Camellia sinensis) in hot water, either as loose tea leaves or encased in porous teabags. Tea is not decaffeinated or flavoured. Does not contain added milk or sugar.

column2: Tea, black, brewed from leaf or teabags, decaffeinated
column3: Beverage prepared by brewing black decaffeinated tea leaves (dried, fermented leaves of Chrysanthemum species) in hot water, either as loose tea leaves or encased in porous teabags. Does not contain added flavours, milk or sugar.
Beverage prepared by brewing green, unfermented tea leaves in hot water, either as loose tea leaves or encased in porous teabags. Does not contain added flavours, milk or sugar.
Carbonated or naturally sparkling ground water obtained from subterranean water-bearing strata that, in its natural state, contains soluble matter. No added sugar or flavours.
Carbonated, non-alcoholic beverage containing 5% citrus juice (orange and lemon), mineral water and sugar.
Still, non-carbonated water bottled prior to sale. May include spring water.
Carbonated water.
Water as supplied through the municipal water system. Values are approximations of those reported across Australia, and may vary according to location or time of year.

column2: Biscuit, savoury, corn cake, plain, salted
column3: Commercially prepared, round or square, savoury dry cake, made from puffed corn and salted.
Commercially prepared savoury biscuit made predominantly from rice flour, with added salt and/or 'original' flavours.

column2: Biscuit, savoury, rice cake, from brown rice, plain

column3: A thin, flat rectangle of dry bread made predominantly from rye flour. Commercially prepared; some brands may include a proportion of wheat flour.
Savoury biscuit based predominately on seeds (e.g. linseed, pumpkin seed, poppy seed, sesame seed) with added salt.

column2: Biscuit, savoury, from white wheat flour, flaky cracker style
column3: Commercially prepared, square, plain savoury biscuit made from white wheat flour, with a flaky or layered texture.

column2: Biscuit, savoury, from white wheat flour, plain snack cracker style
column3: Commercially prepared, small, plain savoury biscuit made from white wheat flour and added fat, sprinkled with salt.

column3: Commercially prepared savoury thin, flat, biscuit made from wholemeal wheat flour (plain varieties).

column3: A thin, flat rectangle of puffed, toasted dry bread made from white wheat flour.
Commercially prepared sweet crunchy oat based biscuit. Typical ingredients include rolled oats, wheat flour, coconut and golden syrup.
Commercially prepared crunchy chocolate flavoured biscuit, commonly containing wheat flour, sugar, cocoa, fats, and eggs.
Commercially prepared sweet crunchy ginger flavoured biscuits.
Commercially prepared sweet plain biscuit, made without added flavourings, chocolate, fruit or nuts.

column2: Biscuit, sweet, plain, sponge finger, commercial
column3: Commercially prepared sweet, plain sponge finger biscuit typically made from wheat flour, sugar, egg and raising agents.
Commercially prepared shortbread-style biscuits. Ingredients may include butter, wheat flour, sugar and rice flour.
Sweet biscuit, often served on top of ice cream. Typically made from wheat flour, cornflour, fat, sugar and salt.
Commercially prepared sweet biscuit made from wheat flour with added wheatmeal.

column2: Cone, wafer style, for ice cream
column3: Wafer shaped into a cone or similar shape, used for serving ice cream.

column2: Bread, flat (pita or Lebanese), white, commercial
column3: Flat bread made from white wheat flour. Includes a range of styles, including Lebanese, pita, naan, tortillas, mountain bread and wraps. May vary in diameter. Contains added folic acid, iodised salt and thiamin. Ready to eat.

column2: Bread, flat (pita or Lebanese), wholemeal, commercial
column3: Double layered, Middle Eastern style flat bread made from wholemeal wheat flour with a small amount of crumb adhering to both crusts. May vary in diameter. Contains added folic acid, iodised salt and thiamin.

Commercial Indian yeast-leavened bread based on white wheat flour, water, oil and yoghurt generally baked in a tandoor-style oven. May contain added vitamins (thiamin, riboflavin, folate), minerals (calcium, iron) and iodised salt.
Single layered flat bread made from white wheat flour, oil, salt and water. Generally contains added folic acid, iodised salt and thiamin.
Single layered flat bread made from white wheat flour and water. Contains added folic acid, iodised salt and thiamin.

column2: Bread, flat wrap or tortilla, corn, commercial
column3: Single layered flat bread made from corn flour and water. May contain wheat flour and added folic acid, iodised salt and thiamin.
Crisp crumbs crushed from white bread which has been dried and packaged before sale. Contains added folic acid and iodised salt.

A ring of baked yeast dough with a chewy centre and a crusty outside. It is typically 8-10cm in diameter. Usually poached in water or steamed before being baked. Contains added folic acid and iodised salt. Ready to eat.
Commercially prepared, sliced or unsliced bread made from white, wheaten bread-making flour and other permitted ingredients. Contains added folic acid, iodine and thiamin. Ready to eat.

column2: Bread, from white flour, Italian-style, commercial
column3: Commercially prepared, Italian style bread made from white, wheaten bread-making flour and other permitted ingredients. Contains added folic acid, iodised salt and thiamin.

Commercial yeast leavened, thin, soft-crusted white bread typically prepared from white wheat flour, olive oil, water, yeast, sugar, salt and sesame seeds. Contains added folic acid, iodised  salt and thiamin.

column2: Bread, from white flour, sour dough, commercial
column3: Commercially prepared sour dough made from white, wheaten bread-making flour and other permitted ingredients. Contains added thiamin, folic acid and iodised salt. Ready to eat.

Commercially prepared, sliced or unsliced bread made from white, wholemeal or rye wheaten bread-making flour and other permitted ingredients. May contain added folic acid and iodine, in addition to thiamin.
Pre-prepared pizza bases made from white flour, purchased in supermarkets. Does not contain any toppings. Usually contains added folic acid, thiamin and iodised salt.

Commercially prepared bread made from white, wheaten bread-making flour and other permitted ingredients. Dough is shaped into individual serves before baking. Contains added folic acid, iodised salt and thiamin.
Commercially prepared, sliced or unsliced bread made from wheat flour containing all the milled constituents of the wheat grain. Contains added folic acid, iodine and thiamin.

Commercially prepared bread made from wholemeal, wheaten bread-making flour and other permitted ingredients. Dough is shaped into individual serves before baking. Contains added folic acid, iodised salt and thiamin. Cooked by toasting after purchase.
Commercially prepared sliced or unsliced bread made from white and/or wholemeal flour with added kibbled grains. Contains added folic acid, iodised salt and thiamin.
Commercially prepared bread made from white and/or wholemeal flour with added kibbled grains. Dough shaped into a single serve before baking. Contains added folic acid, iodised salt and thiamin.
Commercially prepared bread made from a mixture of rye flour, rye meal and kibbled or cracked rye grains, resulting in a dark brown colour. Contains added folic acid, iodised salt, and thiamin.

column2: Bread, from rye flour, dark, commercial
column3: Commercially prepared bread made from rye flour, or a combination of rye and wheat flour. Contains added folic acid, iodised salt and thiamin.

column2: Bread, from rye flour, light, commercial
column3: Commercially prepared bread made from rye flour, or a combination of rye and wheat flour, that is lighter and softer with a milder flavour than dark rye bread. Contains added folic acid, iodised salt and thiamin.

column2: Bread, from rye flour, sour dough
column3: Commercially prepared sour dough made from white, wheaten bread-making flour and rye flour and other permitted ingredients. Contains added thiamin, folic acid and iodised salt.

column2: Bread, from white flour, added fibre
column3: Commercially prepared bread made from white, wheaten bread-making flour and other permitted ingredients. Contains added fibre and/or added high amylose maize starch, folic acid, iodised salt and thiamin.

column2: Bread, from white flour, added omega-3 polyunsaturates
column3: Commercially prepared bread made from white, wheaten bread-making flour and other permitted ingredients. Contains added omega-3 fatty acids, folic acid, iodised salt and thiamin.

column2: Bread, from white Jackaroo flour, added fibre and vitamins B1 & folate & Fe
column3: Commercially prepared bread made from white, wheaten Jackaroo brand bread-making flour specifically formulated in conjunction with the Northern Territory Government. Contains added vitamins B1 and folate, iron and other permitted ingredients.
Commercially prepared bread made from grains other than wheat such as buckwheat groats, cornmeal, rice and quinoa. May contain added folic acid and iodised salt. Ready to eat.
Rich bread, bun or roll made from yeasted wheat flour, eggs, and butter or other fat. May contain added folic acid and iodised salt.

column2: Bread, from white flour, commercial, added dried fruit
column3: Commercially prepared bread made from white wheat flour and containing 10- 25% added dried fruit. Contains added folic acid, iodised salt and thiamin.

column2: Bun, sweet, with dried fruit, uniced
column3: Commercially prepared sweet bun made from yeasted wheat flour, containing added dried fruit, with sugar glaze on the top. Contains added folic acid and iodised salt.

Commercially prepared, batter-based product containing white, wheat flour, approximately 10 cm diameter and 1cm thick. Batter is leavened with yeast or with chemical agents and contains added salt and preservatives. Cooked on one side only and has an open honeycomb structure on the top surface. Contains added folic acid. Toasted until lightly brown.

column2: Muffin, English style, from white flour
column3: A round yeasted dough made from white wheat flour (approximately 8.5 cm in diameter and 2 cm thick) that has been baked. Contains added folic acid and iodised salt.

column2: Breakfast cereal, flakes of corn, unfortified

column2: Breakfast cereal, flakes of corn, added vitamins & minerals (Kellogg's Cornflakes)
column3: Breakfast cereal made from flakes of corn with added vitamins B2, B3, B6, E and folic acid, iron and zinc.

column2: Breakfast cereal, mixed grain (wheat, corn, rice & oat), flakes, dried fruit & nuts, added vitamins & minerals (Kellogg's Sustain)
column3: Breakfast cereal made from flakes of wheat, rice, oats and corn with added dried fruit, nuts and salt. Contains added vitamins B2, B3, B6, folic acid and iron and zinc.

column2: Breakfast cereal, mixed grain (wheat, rice & oat), flakes, honey, unfortified (Be Natural Honey Flakes)
column3: Breakfast cereal made from flakes of wheat, oats, rice and triticale with added honey, sugar and salt. Does not contain any added vitamins and minerals.

column3: Breakfast cereal made from flakes of lightly toasted rice and wheat grains with sugar and salt added. Contains added vitamins B2, B3, B6, D and folic acid and calcium, iron and zinc.

column2: Breakfast cereal, mixed grain (wheat, oat & corn), added vitamins & minerals (Kellogg's Nutri-grain)
column3: Breakfast cereal made from wheat, oatmeal and maize flour with added sugar and salt extruded into various shapes before packaging. Contains added vitamins B2, B3, B6 and folic acid and calcium, iron and zinc.

column3: Breakfast cereal made from flakes of wheat, oats and triticale with dried sultanas, apricot, sugar and salt. Contains added vitamins B2, B3, B6 and folic acid and iron and zinc.

column3: Breakfast cereal made from toasted puffed or popped rice grains. Does not contain added salt, sugar, vitamins or minerals.

column3: Breakfast cereal made from toasted puffed or popped rice grains with added salt and sugar. Contains added vitamins B2, B3, C and folic acid, iron and zinc.

column2: Breakfast cereal, puffed or popped rice, cocoa coating, added vitamins & minerals (Kellogg's Coco Pops)
column3: Chocolate flavoured puffed rice cereal with added sugar and salt. Contains added vitamins B1, B2, B3, C and folic acid, and calcium, iron and zinc.

column2: Breakfast cereal, whole wheat, puffed, no added sugar or salt, unfortified
column3: Breakfast cereal made from puffed whole wheat. Does not contain any added sugar, salt or vitamins or minerals.

column3: Breakfast cereal made from whole wheat and salt formed into a biscuit shape. Does not contain any added sugar, vitamins or minerals.

column3: Breakfast cereal made from whole wheat flakes with added salt. Contains added vitamins B1, B2, B3 and folic acid.

column3: Breakfast cereal made from whole wheat flakes with added wheat bran, dried fruit, nuts and salt. Contains added fibre, vitamins B1, B2, B3 and folic acid and calcium and iron.

column2: Breakfast cereal, wheat bran, flakes, sultanas, added vitamins & minerals (Kellogg's Sultana Bran)
column3: Breakfast cereal made from wheat bran flakes with added sultanas. Contains added vitamins B2, B3, B6 and folic acid and iron and zinc.

column2: Muesli, granola, toasted, added nuts & seeds, unfortified

column2: Muesli, granola, non-oat based, toasted, added nuts & seeds, unfortified

column2: Muesli, toasted, added dried fruit & nuts, unfortified
column3: Breakfast cereal made from rolled oats, dried fruit and other ingredients such as nuts, coconut and seeds, and then toasted with the addition of vegetable oil. Does not contain added vitamins or minerals.

column3: Breakfast cereal made from rolled oats, dried fruit (including sultanas, currants, apricot, pawpaw, banana, apple and pineapple) and other ingredients including wheat bran, wheat germ, sugar, and/or seeds. Includes mueslis with a small amount of added nuts (less than 3%) including almond, coconut, walnut, hazelnut and pecans. Does not contain added vitamins or minerals.

Commercially prepared dry plain cake mix. Typical ingredients include wheat flour, maize starch, sugar, salt, dairy products, vegetable oils, flavours, colours and baking agents. Includes cake mixes labelled as madeira, tea cake or vanilla cake.

column2: Cake, sponge, plain, commercial, uniced, unfilled
column3: Commercially prepared light sponge cake prepared with minimal added fat and with a significant proportion of eggs.
Commercially prepared pikelet. Contains added folic acid, iodised salt and thiamin.
Commercially prepared, dough-like product made from flour, water, sugar, fat and a raising agent.
Home prepared dough-like product made from common household ingredients such as flour, milk, sugar, fat, egg and a raising agent.
Very small, round grains, with a light sandy/beige colour.
Grain that has had the bran removed, then is steamed and polished. Uncooked.

column2: Barley, pearl, boiled, no added fat or salt
column3: Grain that has had the bran removed, then is steamed and polished. Prepared by boiling in unsalted water until tender without the addition of fat or salt.
Grain that has been developed to be high in fibre. It has had the bran removed, then is steamed and pressed into flakes. Uncooked.
Hulled, crushed, roasted kernels, used in a similar manner to rice. Uncooked.

column2: Buckwheat groats, cooked in water, no added salt
column3: Buck wheat, hulled, crushed, roasted kernels, used in a similar manner to rice. Cooked in unsalted water without the addition of fat or salt.
A quick-cooking form of whole wheat that has been cleaned, parboiled, dried, ground into particles and sifted into distinct sizes (fine, medium and course grinds). As purchased, not cooked.

column2: Bulgur, soaked in water, no added fat or salt
column3: A quick-cooking form of whole wheat that have been cleaned, parboiled, dried, ground into particles and sifted into distinct sizes (fine, medium and course grinds). Prepared by soaking in unsalted water.
A starch extracted from the pith of the sago (and other tropical) palms that is processed into flour, meal and pearl sago. It is used as a thickening agent. Uncooked.

column2: Sago, cooked in water, no added salt
column3: A starch extracted from the pith of the sago (and other tropical) palms that is processed into flour, meal and pearl sago. Cooked in unsalted water without the addition of fat or oil.
A type of flour ground from dried kernels of yellow or white corn. Uncooked.

column2: Cornmeal (polenta), boiled, no added fat or salt
column3: A type of flour ground from dried kernels of yellow or white corn. Cooked in unsalted water without the addition of fat or salt.
Cream coloured pellets made from approximately 2 parts semolina, 1 part wheat flour and salt and water, then steamed and dried. No further cooking.

column2: Couscous, boiled, no added fat or salt
column3: Cream coloured pellets, made from approximately 2 parts semolina, 1 part wheat flour and salt and water, then steamed and dried. Subsequently cooked by soaking in boiling water, without the addition of fat or salt.
Uncooked hulled cereal grain.

column2: Millet, boiled, no added fat or salt
column3: Hulled cereal grain, cooked in water by the absorption method, without the addition of fat or salt.
Small, yellow, broken grains of corn.
The rough outer covering of the oat (located under the husk), that has not undergone further processing other than packaging.
A tan coloured, oval-shaped, cylindrical grain that have had their outer husk removed. Uncooked.
Crushed grain produced by steaming and flattening with hot rollers. No further cooking. Includes traditional and quick cooking styles.
Husk of a small seed which is high in dietary fibre. Uncooked
Small black seed which has a light, fluffy texture when cooked. Mild and slightly nutty flavour. Uncooked
Small rusty red seed which has a light, fluffy texture when cooked. Mild and slightly nutty flavour. Uncooked
Small beige seed which has a light, fluffy texture when cooked. Mild and slightly nutty flavour. Uncooked
Small, oval-shaped brown grains. Uncooked, unmilled.
Crushed grain produced by steaming and flattening with hot rollers. Uncooked.
Small, round grain that is orange-red in colour. Can be milled into flour or kibbled (cut into) 3 or 4 pieces.
A very small grass seed which is white to a deep reddish brown in colour. Typically ground and used to make traditional flat bread such as injera. Uncooked.
A beige coloured, long, oval-shaped grain that is a wheat-rye hybrid. Can be milled into flour or kibbled (cut) into 3 or 4 pieces.
Coarsely ground starchy product from the inner endosperm of durum wheat. It is granular in appearance and ranges from clear to yellow in colour. Uncooked.

column2: Semolina, boiled, no added fat or salt
column3: Coarsely ground starchy product from the inner endosperm of durum wheat. It is granular in appearance and ranges from clear to yellow in colour. Cooked in unsalted water without the addition of fat or salt.
Small uncooked grain from the wheat family. Uncooked.

column2: Spelt, boiled, no added fat or salt
column3: Small uncooked grain from the wheat family. Uncooked.

column2: Tapioca, pearl or seed style, uncooked
column3: Starchy product from the cassava plant supplied in the form of small pellets (also known as seeds or pearls). Sometimes sold labelled as Sago tapioca or Sago. Imported into Australia. Uncooked.

column2: Tapioca, pearl or seed style, boiled, no added fat or salt
column3: Starchy product supplied in the form of small pellets (also known as seeds or pearls). Sometimes sold labelled as Sago tapioca or Sago. Cooked by boiling according to label instructions.
Outer layers of the wheat grain which are removed during the early stages of milling, and do not undergo further processing other than packaging. Maybe coarsely or finely milled. Uncooked.
Whole wheat grain including the bran, germ and endosperm.
Small creamy flakes milled from the core of the wheat kernel.
Grain that has had its husk, bran and germ removed. The grains after milling have a slight off-white colour. Uncooked.

column2: Rice, white, boiled or rice cooker, no added salt
column3: Grain that has had its husk, bran and germ removed. Cooked by boiling on the stove top or in an electric rice cooker in unsalted water.
Grain that has had its husk, bran and germ removed. Pre-cooked before purchase, then heated in the microwave.
Grain with only the inedible outer husk removed. The bran coating gives it a light tan colour. Uncooked.

column2: Rice, brown, boiled, no added salt
column3: Grain with only the inedible outer husk removed. Cooked by boiling in unsalted water.
A long-grain marsh grass. Uncooked.

column2: Rice, wild, boiled, no added salt
column3: A long-grain marsh grass. Cooked by boiling in unsalted water.

column2: Rice paper wrapper, soaked in water
column3: Thin edible paper used to prepare rice paper rolls or summer rolls, typically made from rice flour, salt and water. Sold dried in thin, translucent round or square sheets that are crisp to the touch. Soaked in water with no added oil or salt. Does not contain any fillings.
Flour ground from the starchy roots of a number of tropical plants.
Fine white powder extracted from the starchy endosperm of maize (corn).

column2: Flour, cornflour, from maize & wheat starch
column3: Fine white powder extracted from the starchy endosperm of maize (corn) or wheat. Sold in Australia under the name of cornflour.
Flour prepared from dried, ground chick peas.
Flour mix prepared from white gluten free starches and flours including rice, tapioca and corn/maize.
Flour ground from grains of white and/or brown rice.
A flour made from the milled wholegrain of rye.
Creamy, finely ground flour processed from soya beans.
Flour prepared from ground spelt, a type of wheat.

column2: Flour, wheat, white, high protein or bread making flour
column3: High protein wheat flour which may contain added gluten to achieve a protein content ranging from 12-16%. Suitable for use in bread making. Contains added thiamin and folic acid.
Flour prepared from ground wheat from which bran has been removed. No added vitamins,  minerals or leavening agents.

column2: Flour, wheat, white, plain, added vitamins B1, B2, B3, B6, E & folate & Fe, Mg & Zn (Jackaroo)
column3: Flour prepared from ground wheat from which bran has been removed. Specifically formulated in conjunction with the Northern Territory Government. Contains added vitamins B1, B2, B3, B6, E and folate, iron, magnesium and zinc.
Flour prepared from ground wheat from which bran has been removed. Chemical leavening agents added. No added vitamins or minerals.

column2: Flour, wheat, white, self-raising, added vitamins B1, B2, B3, B6, E & folate & Fe, Mg & Zn (Jackaroo)
column3: Flour prepared from ground wheat from which bran has been removed. Specifically formulated in conjunction with the Northern Territory Government. Contains added chemical leavening agents and vitamins B1, B2, B3, B6, E and folate, iron, magnesium and zinc.
Flour milled from whole wheat grain (bran, germ and flour). No added vitamins, minerals or leavening agents.
Flour milled from whole wheat grain (bran, germ and flour) to which chemical leavening agents have been added. No added vitamins or minerals.
Protein rich extract of wheat flour.
Fine powder composed of polysaccharides derived from the potato tuber.
Commercially prepared noodles made from a paste of water and ground rice, or rice with cornflour, which are then dried and coiled. Cooked by boiling without added fat or salt and then drained.
Commercially prepared dry noodles made from a mix of wheat and buckwheat flour. Uncooked.
Commercially prepared dry noodles made from a mix of wheat and buckwheat flour, boiled in unsalted water and then drained.

Commercially prepared, moist, wheat based noodle, commonly used in Asian style cooking. Includes noodles described as Hokkien, Singapore and Chow Mein noodles. Cooked by boiling without added fat or salt.

column2: Noodle, wheat, instant, unflavoured, boiled, drained
column3: Commercially prepared noodle made from wheat flour, vegetable oil, salts and vegetable gums, coiled into blocks and dried before packaging. Cooked by heating in boiling water without contents of flavour sachet. Drained of excess water.

column2: Noodle, wheat, instant, unflavoured, dry, uncooked
column3: Commercially prepared noodle made from wheat flour, vegetable oil, salts and vegetable gums, coiled into blocks and dried before packaging. Does not include contents of flavour sachet. Uncooked.

column2: Noodle, wheat with egg, plain, boiled, no added fat
column3: The dough made by combining wheat flour or semolina (preferably durum wheat) with eggs. Cooked by boiling without added fat or salt.

column2: Pasta, gluten free, boiled from dry, no added salt
column3: The dough made from grains other than wheat such as corn and rice with added water. Cooked in boiling water without added salt or fat until firm to the bite. Drained.

column2: Pasta, legume based, boiled, no added salt
column3: The dough is made by combining legume flour (pea, chickpea, soy bean, bean, and/or lentil) with water. Cooked in boiling water without added salt or fat until firm to the bite. Drained.
The dough made by combining wheat flour or semolina (preferably durum semolina) with water. The dough is then dried before packaging and sale.

column2: Pasta, white wheat flour, boiled from dry, no added salt
column3: The dough made by combining wheat flour or semolina (usually durum semolina) with water. Cooked in boiling water without added salt or fat until firm to the bite. Drained.

column2: Pasta, white wheat flour, fresh, uncooked
column3: Commercial product prepared from white wheat flour and other ingredients and cut to shape, but not dried prior to packaging. Includes fresh pasta containing egg. Uncooked.

column2: Pasta, white wheat flour, fresh, boiled, no added salt
column3: Commercial product prepared from white wheat flour and other ingredients and cut to shape, but not dried prior to packaging. Includes fresh pasta containing egg. Boiled without added salt or fat, although the pasta itself is likely to contain added salt.

column2: Pasta, white wheat flour & egg, dry
column3: The dough made by combining wheat flour or semolina (preferably durum wheat) with eggs. The dough is then dried prior to sale.

column2: Pasta, white wheat flour & egg, boiled from dry, no added salt
column3: The dough made by combining wheat flour or semolina (preferably durum wheat) with eggs. Cooked by boiling without added fat or salt until firm to the bite. Drained.

column2: Pasta, white wheat flour & spinach, dry
column3: The dough made by combining white wheat flour or semolina (preferably durum wheat) with water and spinach. The dough is then dried before packaging and sale. Uncooked.

column2: Pasta, white wheat flour & spinach, boiled from dry, no added salt
column3: The dough made by combining white wheat flour or semolina (preferably durum wheat) with water and spinach. The dough is then dried before packaging and sale. Cooked by boiling without added fat or salt until firm to the bite. Drained.

The dough made by combining wheat flour (with varying proportions of whole-wheat grain and white flour) or semolina (preferably durum semolina) with water. The dough is then dried before packaging and sale. Uncooked.

column2: Pasta, wholemeal wheat flour, boiled from dry, no added salt
column3: The dough made by combining wheat flour (with varying proportions of whole-wheat grain and white flour) or semolina (preferably durum semolina) with water. The dough is then dried before packaging and sale. Cooked by boiling without added fat or salt until firm to the bite. Drained.

column2: Spaghetti in tomato & cheese sauce, canned
column3: Commercially prepared canned pasta product containing spaghetti in tomato and cheese sauce.

column2: Spaghetti in tomato & cheese sauce, canned, reduced salt
column3: Commercially prepared canned pasta product containing spaghetti in a reduced salt tomato and cheese sauce.

Commercially prepared crescent-shaped pastry prepared from ingredients such as wheat flour, butter, yeast, sugar, egg, milk powder and food additives, then baked. Sodium content likely to vary widely depending on ingredients.
Dough made with wheat flour, egg, water and salt. Purchased frozen from speciality supermarkets for use as dumpling wrappers.
Uncooked commercial thin sheets of wheat flour based pastry, prepared without added fat, used in preparation of strudels and Greek-style pastry dishes.
Baked commercial thin sheets of wheat flour based pastry, prepared without added fat, used in preparation of strudels and Greek-style pastry dishes.

column2: Pastry, puff, with butter, commercial, raw
column3: Uncooked pastry purchased ready-to-cook from supermarkets. Pastry may be sold in thin sheets or in blocks that need to be rolled. Produces a pastry that contains multiple fine layers and is often used on the top of pies. Typical ingredients include wheat flour, butter, salt, citric acid and preservative.

column2: Pastry, puff, with butter, commercial, baked
column3: Pastry purchased uncooked from supermarkets and then baked at home. Pastry may be sold in thin sheets or in blocks that need to be rolled. Produces a pastry that contains multiple fine layers and is often used on the top of pies. Typical ingredients include wheat flour, butter, salt, citric acid and preservative.

column2: Pastry, puff, vegetable oil, commercial, raw
column3: Uncooked pastry purchased ready-to-cook from supermarkets. Pastry may be sold in thin sheets or in blocks that need to be rolled. Produces a pastry that contains multiple fine layers and is often used on the top of pies. Typical ingredients include wheat flour, vegetable oil, salt, citric acid and preservative.

column2: Pastry, puff, vegetable oil, commercial, baked
column3: Pastry purchased uncooked from supermarkets and then baked at home. Pastry may be sold in thin sheets or in blocks that need to be rolled. Produces a pastry that contains multiple fine layers and is often used on the top of pies. Typical ingredients include wheat flour, vegetable oil, salt, citric acid and preservative.

Uncooked pastry purchased in thin sheets or blocks from supermarkets. Produces a firm pastry often used on the base of pies. Typical ingredients include wheat flour, vegetable fat, glycerol, citric acid and water.

Pastry purchased in thin sheets or blocks from supermarkets and baked at home. Produces a firm pastry often used on the base of pies. Typical ingredients include wheat flour, vegetable fat, glycerol, citric acid and water.

column2: Dressing, French or Italian, regular fat, commercial
column3: Commercially prepared thin sauce used to dress salads. Major ingredients include water, vegetable oil, sugar, vinegar, garlic and spices.

column2: Dressing, thousand island, regular fat, commercial
column3: Commercially prepared thick white, beige or light orange coloured cream, emulsified sauce used to dress salads and seafood. Major ingredients include vegetable oil, vinegar, milk powder, tomato, sugar, egg and seasonings.
Whitish root vegetable, grated and mixed with vinegar and salt.
Commercially prepared white, emulsified sauce with a similar thick consistency to cream. Used in sandwiches or to dress salads. Major ingredients include oil, sugar, vinegar and egg.

A white, emulsified sauce with a similar thick consistency to cream, using lower levels of oil to develop a product with a low fat content. Used in sandwiches and to dress salads. Major ingredients include oil, sugar and vinegar.
Thick, dark brown concentrated beef extract paste. Typically added to soups and stews for flavouring or to hot water as a beverage. Contains added salt.

Yellowish paste prepared from ground mustard seeds (typically 10 - 30% of total product), water, vinegar, salt and herbs or other spices. Sold packaged in jars and used as a condiment without further preparation.
Commercially prepared Indian style curry paste sauce. Ingredients may include water, tomato and onion puree, vegetable oil, chilli, garlic, ginger, herbs & spices and colours and flavourings.
Commercially prepared paste containing green chilli, onions, salt, spices, herbs, vegetable oil and other ingredients, used for preparing south-east Asian style main dishes.
A thick paste made from fermented and processed soya beans mixed with grain and injected with a yeast mould.
Commercially prepared dark, pungent paste prepared from shrimp and used as a flavouring in Asian style cooking.
Commercially prepared hot, green paste typically made with horseradish, wasabi root, oil, water and salt. Commonly consumed with sushi or sashimi.

Commercially prepared sweet, thick, brown coloured, bottled sauce containing apples, sugar, Worcestershire sauce, golden syrup, food acid, thickener, salt, molasses, mixed citrus peel, raisins, spices, vegetable gum and water.
Commercially prepared Indian style butter chicken sauce. Commonly contains water, tomatoes, onions, vegetable oil, cream, butter, sugar, salt, spices, garlic, chilli and colour.
Commercially prepared jellied or semi-jellied sweet jam-like sauce made from cranberries, sugars and water.
Commercially prepared sauce based on fish or anchovy extract, and salt, commonly used in Asian style cooking.
Commercially prepared sweet, spicy bottled sauce based on fermented soya beans with other ingredients.

Commercially prepared sauce based on oyster extract, sugar, caramel, salt, starch, flavour, protein or hydrolysed vegetable protein, soy sauce, preservative, sodium benzoate, water, food conditioner. Commonly used in Asian-style cooking.

column2: Sauce, pasta or simmer, commercial, low fat
column3: Commercially prepared sauce for use as a simmer/pasta bake sauce, formulated so as to contain less than 3% fat. Typical ingredients include water, thickener, cheese, onion, garlic, salt, flavours, herbs and spices.
Commercially prepared basil pesto flavoured pasta sauce. Commonly containing basil, vegetable and /or olive oil, cashews, pine nuts, water, cheese, sugar, salt and garlic.
Commercially prepared tomato-based pasta sauce with herbs, spices and vegetables for addition to pasta dishes. Heated without added ingredients according to label instructions.
Commercially prepared chutney-style, spicy, sweet, hot sauce, based on plums.
Commercially prepared Indian style Rogan Josh flavoured sauce. Commonly contains water, vegetable oil, salt, coriander, ginger, chilli, spices, gram flour and pepper.
Commercially prepared Mexican style, tomato based dip. Typical ingredients include tomato, onion, capsicum, jalapenos, salt and chilli.

Commercially prepared simmer/bake sauce intended for use with chicken dishes. Typical base ingredients  include water, vegetable oil, onion, thickener, flavours, herbs and spices. Additional ingredients may be included depending on the flavour of the simmer sauce.
Commercially prepared dark brown salty liquid sauce commonly containing hydrolysed soy protein, hydrolysed wheat protein, salt, colour (caramel) and water.

Commercially prepared dark brown, salty, liquid sauce commonly containing hydrolysed soy protein, hydrolysed wheat protein, salt, colour (caramel) and water. Reduced in salt compared to regular soy sauce.
Commercially prepared spicy sauce made from red peppers.
Commercially prepared sauce with a thick consistency. Contains tomatoes, sugar, salt, food acid and spices.
Commercially prepared sauce with a thick consistency formulated to have less added salt than regular commercial tomato sauce. Contains tomatoes, sugar, salt, food acid and spices.

column2: Sauce, tomato, reduced sugar & salt, commercial
column3: Commercially prepared sauce with a thick consistency formulated to have less added sugar and salt than regular commercial tomato sauce. Contains tomatoes, sugar, salt, food acid and spices.
Commercially prepared fermented liquid condiment made with vinegar, molasses, golden syrup, salt, water, spices, soy sauce, pepper, tamarinds, anchovies, lemon oil, onion and garlic powder.
Sour liquid prepared by acetous fermentation, with or without alcoholic fermentation, of any suitable foodstuff, commonly used in dressings. Available types of vinegar include white, brown and malt.

Sour liquid prepared by acetous fermentation. Balsamic vinegar is based on wine vinegar complemented by concentrated and cooked grape must, ageing allowing aroma to further develop. Commonly used in dressings and as a taste enhancer in various recipes

column2: Peanut butter, smooth & crunchy, added sugar & salt
column3: Commercial paste made from roasted and ground peanuts. Available in two types with (crunchy) and without (smooth) chunks of peanuts. Contains vegetable oil, added sugar and salt.

column2: Peanut butter, smooth & crunchy, no added sugar or salt
column3: Commercial paste made from roasted, unsalted and ground peanuts. Available in two types with (crunchy) and with out (smooth) chunks of peanuts. Does not contain added salt or sugar.
Commercial thick, dark brown concentrated yeast extract spread. Contains added salt, and vitamins B1, B2 and B3.
Commercial, thick dark brown, salty concentrated yeast extract spread made by treating yeast with acid. Contains added salt, and vitamins B1, B2 and B3.

Prepared by the addition of culture, rennet and mould spores to cows milk to produce green, grey, blue or black spots of mould throughout the body of the cheese. Includes Australian and imported blue cheese.
Fresh, soft cheese made from cows milk. Sold shaped into small balls and packed in brine or water.

Australian and imported soft cheese covered with white mould and labelled as being brie style or double brie. Prepared by pasteurising, culturing and coagulating cows milk prior to salting and curing.

Prepared by pasteurising, culturing and coagulating cows milk prior to salting and curing to produce a soft creamy surface ripened cheese. Includes Australian and imported soft cheese covered with white mould and labelled as being camembert style.
Cheddar cheese prepared by curdling cows milk with rennet, followed by curing to produce a hard pale yellow cheese. Includes unsliced mild, tasty and vintage varieties.
Cheddar cheese prepared by curdling cows milk with rennet, followed by curing to produce a hard pale yellow cheese. Formulated to have a fat content of approximately 25%.

Commercially prepared regular fat processed cheddar cheese. Prepared by grinding, mixing, melting and emulsifying one or more varieties of cheese with salt to form a homogeneous mass. Supplied as slices or blocks.

column2: Cheese, cheddar, processed, reduced fat (approximately 15%), added vitamin D
column3: Commercially prepared processed cheddar cheese formulated to contain approximately 16% fat. Prepared by grinding, mixing, melting and emulsifying one or more varieties of cheese with salt and vitamin D to form a homogeneous mass. Supplied as slices or blocks.
Regular fat creamed cottage cheese, prepared by curdling, salting, draining and washing cows milk to produce an unripened, white curd cheese.
Regular fat soft, white cheese prepared by blending, culturing and salting cows milk, cream and vegetable gum.
A semi-hard cheese made by curdling cows milk with rennet, followed by curing. Coated in oil or a red or yellow wax film. Includes Australian and imported edam cheese.
Made by curdling cows milk with rennet, which is then sliced, salted and stored in either whey or brine. Includes Australian and imported fetta cheese.
Cheese made from goats milk. Firm in texture.
Cheese made from goats milk. Soft in texture.
Cheese prepared by curdling cow's milk with rennet, followed by curing to produce a semi-hard, yellow cheese that is then coated in a wax rind.
Salty, semi-soft cheese that maintains its texture when cooked.
Salty, semi-soft cheese that maintains its texture when cooked. Formulated to be lower in salt than regular haloumi.
Cheese prepared by curdling cow's milk with rennet, followed by curing to produce a semi-hard, pale-yellow cheese.
Cheese made from cows milk with a rubbery texture. Typically added to pizza and other Italian-style dishes.

Parmesan-style cheese, prepared by removing the majority of cream from cows milk before heating, curdling and brining. Cheese is finely grated prior to sale and some additional moisture may be removed, so that the cheese does not generally require refrigerator storage.
A hard granular cheese prepared by removing the majority of cream from cows milk before heating, curdling and brining.
Cheese prepared by culturing and coagulating cow's milk to form curds that are stretched and kneaded until smooth, then shaped. The cheese is then coated in a wax rind.
Cheese prepared by curdling, salting, draining and washing cow's milk to produce an unripened, white curd cheese.
Australian produced ricotta cheese. Prepared by collecting the whey from the coagulation of cows milk and further separation and draining.
Cheese prepared by curdling cow's milk with rennet, followed by curing to produce a hard to semi-hard, yellow cheese containing characteristic holes. Often sold with a wax rind.

Australian produced thickened cream with a fat content of 35%. Major ingredients include cream, gelatine and vegetable gum. Produced by separating milk into a highly concentrated milk fat stream (cream) and a non-milk fat stream (skim milk) and adding thickener to increase the viscosity.
Commercially produced Australian sour cream with a fat content of approximately 35% Prepared by culturing cream or milk with lactic acid bacteria resulting in the sour flavour.

Commercially produced Australian sour cream with a fat content of approximately 18%. Prepared by culturing a combination of cows milk cream and milk with lactic acid bacteria resulting in the sour flavour and decreased fat content compared to regular sour cream.
Commercially produced soft product with a creamy appearance and texture that is commonly used in baked goods in place of whipped dairy cream, but which is not dairy-based.

column2: Ice cream, vanilla flavour, regular fat
column3: Commercial product prepared by mixing milk, sugar, gums, emulsifiers and vanilla flavour, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream to give it a light texture. Includes varieties with a fat content of 11%. Some analysed samples contain egg yolk.

column2: Ice cream, vanilla flavour, premium or rich (approximately 15% fat)
column3: Vanilla ice cream. Major ingredients include cream, milk, sugar, gums and emulsifiers. Prepared by freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give a light texture. Includes premium and gourmet ice creams with fat content ~15%. Some samples contain egg yolk.
Reduced fat cow's milk which has been fermented by the addition of bacterial cultures. Product remains a liquid and does not contain added flavours.

column2: Milk, cow, fluid, regular fat (3.5% fat)
column3: Australian produced regular fat cows milk. Supplied with a minimum fat content of 3.2 g milk fat/100 g.

column2: Milk, cow, fluid, regular fat (3.5% fat), added omega 3 polyunsaturates
column3: Australian produced regular fat cows milk to which sources of omega-3 fatty acids are added. Supplied with fat content of approximately 3.4%.

column2: Milk, cow, fluid, reduced fat (1% fat)
column3: Australian produced reduced fat cows milk. Supplied with fat content of approximately 1%.

column2: Milk, cow, fluid, reduced fat (1.5% fat), added omega 3 polyunsaturates
column3: Australian produced reduced fat cows milk. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 1%, with added sources of omega-3 fatty acids.
Australian produced cows skim milk. Supplied with a maximum fat content of 0.15%.

column2: Milk, cow, fluid, lactose free, regular fat (3.5% fat)
column3: Australian produced regular fat cows milk. Lactase enzyme added to pre-digest naturally-occurring lactose. Supplied with a fat content of 3.5%.

column2: Milk, cow, fluid, lactose free, reduced fat (1% fat)
column3: Australian produced regular fat cows milk. Lactase enzyme added to pre-digest naturally-occurring lactose. Supplied with a fat content of 1%.
Canned milk prepared by evaporating approximately 60% of the water content of regular fat cows milk prior to sterilisation.

column2: Milk, cow, canned, evaporated, reduced fat (approximately 2% fat)
column3: Canned milk prepared by evaporating approximately 60% of the water content of regular fat and skim cows milk prior to sterilisation. Formulated to have a fat content of 2%.
Canned milk prepared by evaporating approximately 60% of the water content of skim cow's milk prior to sterilisation.

column2: Milk, cow, canned, sweetened, condensed, regular
column3: Milk product prepared by adding sugar to regular fat cows milk prior to evaporation of approximately 50% of the water content. Includes both canned and tube varieties.

column2: Milk, canned, sweetened, condensed, skim (~0.2% fat)
column3: Canned milk prepared by adding sugar to skim cow's milk prior to evaporation of approximately 50% of the water content.

column2: Milk, cow, powder, regular fat, unfortified
column3: Regular fat cows milk powder, prepared by removing water from regular fat milk by spray-drying. May also contain lecithin.

column2: Milk, cow, powder, regular fat, added vitamins A & D
column3: Regular fat cows milk powder, prepared by removing water from regular fat milk by spray-drying. Contains added vitamins A and D. May also contain lecithin.
Cows skim milk powder, prepared by removing the majority of water from skim cows milk by spray drying.
Australian produced goat's milk. Pasteurised (regular or ultra-high temperature) and homogenised.
Powder prepared by removing the majority of water from regular fat goat's milk by spray-drying.
Commercially produced regular fat vanilla flavoured custard. Major ingredients include regular fat milk, sugar, flavour and thickener. Custard does not contain eggs.
Dry yellow powder used for making custard. Ingredients include cornflour, salt, colours and flavours.

Unflavoured (natural) yoghurt. Prepared by pasteurising and homogenising cows milk before culturing, resulting in a thickened, tangy yoghurt. Contains added milk powder. Formulated to have a fat content of approximately 4%. Does not contain fruit or flavouring.
Sheep's milk yoghurt. Prepared by pasteurising and homogenising sheep's milk before culturing, resulting in a thickened, tangy yoghurt.
A dairy milk substitute made from water, almonds, sweetened with sugar or rice syrup.
